create_quaternion_from_axis_angle: create a quaternion from an axis-angle tensor using from_axis_angle
rotate_vector_by_quaternion: rotate a 3D vector by a quaternion using rotate_vector
slerp_between_quaternions: interpolate between two quaternions using slerp with a t parameter
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert quaternions to 3x3 rotation matrices using to_rotation_matrix
blend_multiple_quaternions: blend multiple quaternions together with optional weights using blend
